Method of Attack: URL spoofing vulnerability allowing spoofing URLs in Xiaomi Mint Browser and Mi Browser address bar
Bypassing patches with crafted URLs to display arbitrary domain names in address bar
Phishing attacks leveraging URL spoofing to deceive users
Attack Vector: Malicious crafted URLs with query portions causing address bar spoofing
Indicators of Compromise: Spoofed address bar showing incorrect domain names (e.g., Yahoo! page showing Facebook URL)
Presence of vulnerability in Mint Browser versions 1.6.3 and 1.6.4
Unpatched Mi Browser last updated December 3, 2018
